text: Travelodge staff gave domestic abuser key to his victim's room. A woman told the BBC her attacker kicked her hotel room door off its hinges after reception gave him the key.
Bungalow destroyed in explosion captured on camera. Footage showed the home burning after an explosion thought to have been caused by a gas leak.
Body in suitcase found in Australia turns out to be lifelike doll. Forensics revealed that the realistic-looking body was not human.
